item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-cc79aa7688e60af5","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"The article reports that during Hasina’s rule, law-enforcement agencies were used to crush opposition and silence dissent, with allegations of enforced disappearances of around 900 people; it also describes oversight bodies as ineffective and parliamentary watchdogs as paralysed. These are retrospective allegations published after the period, not adjudicated findings.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.5","3B.8","3B.10","4B.3","4B.4","4B.9","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The claims concern Hasina’s rule through 5 August 2024 and therefore overlap 2023, but the source was published in August 2024.","ruler_attribution":"The article attributes the alleged institutional capture and repression to Hasina’s government and its associates.","limitations":["Claims are presented in an opinion/analysis article and are not independently adjudicated within the document."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cc79aa7688e60af5","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"The article alleges that Hasina’s government politicised law-enforcement agencies, the judiciary, civil administration, and economic and political institutions; it describes the 2014 election as involving 153 uncontested MPs and alleges ballot-box stuffing and opposition suppression in subsequent elections.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.4","3B.8","4B.1","4B.2","4B.3","4B.4","4B.5","4B.8","4B.9","7B.5","8B.5","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The evidence is historical and includes the 2014, 2018, and 2024 electoral cycles; it is relevant to the institutional conditions inherited into 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The article attributes the alleged politicisation and electoral manipulation to Hasina and loyal associates.","limitations":["The document is a retrospective commentary and includes allegations rather than a court-established account."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cc79aa7688e60af5","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"The article alleges that politically connected businesspeople and officials received privileged access, promotions, contracts, bank control, and impunity, citing alleged large-scale embezzlement, bank takeovers, illicit outflows, and failure to prosecute some accused actors.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.5","5B.7","5B.10","7B.3","7B.4","7B.5","7B.6","7B.7","7B.9","7B.10","8B.3","8B.4","8B.5","8B.6","8B.8","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The allegations concern the long Hasina period and the financial conditions visible in and around 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The article presents the alleged favoritism and impunity as enabled by Hasina’s government.","limitations":["The source uses allegations and reported complaints; individual amounts and responsibility are not independently verified here."]},{"source_id":"SRC-afb313a7e45fa3f7","start_unit":7,"end_unit":12,"fact_summary":"In a January 2015 address, Hasina claimed that her government had pursued development, parliamentary committee monitoring, free media, a Right to Information Act, anti-corruption strengthening, women’s empowerment, social safety programs, expanded health and education services, infrastructure, and a peaceful foreign-policy principle.","question_ids":["2B.10","3B.7","4B.3","4B.4","4B.6","4B.7","5B.1","5B.6","6B.1","6B.2","6B.3","6B.9","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The speech describes claimed achievements through 2014, providing an official baseline and program continuity relevant to 2023 but not direct 2023 outcome evidence.","ruler_attribution":"These are Hasina’s own claims about her government.","limitations":["The speech is self-reported and predates 2023; its quantitative claims are not independently corroborated in the document."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8a87e00cd2f38ba9","start_unit":3,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"In the 27 December 2023 election-manifesto speech, Hasina presented a detailed program and comparative 2006-to-2023 indicators, claiming higher growth, income, budget size, exports, remittances, investment, and revenue, while acknowledging that the figures represented government-reported comparisons.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.6","5B.7","5B.10","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly dated 27 December 2023 and explicitly reports 2023 indicators.","ruler_attribution":"Hasina presented the program and claimed outcomes as Awami League government achievements.","limitations":["The figures are manifesto claims and are not independently validated in the supplied document."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8a87e00cd2f38ba9","start_unit":8,"end_unit":23,"fact_summary":"The 2023 manifesto reports expanded electricity access, health staffing and facilities, literacy and school participation, agricultural production and subsidies, digital services, housing rehabilitation, social-safety-net allocations and beneficiaries, women’s labor participation, employment, and higher minimum wages.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.8","5B.10","6B.1","6B.2","6B.3","6B.4","6B.6","6B.8","6B.9","6B.10","8B.2","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The comparisons explicitly identify the 2023 position, with some figures dated November 2023 or earlier.","ruler_attribution":"The manifesto attributes the reported expansion to the Awami League government.","limitations":["The source is a party manifesto; reported indicators may use selective baselines and are not independently audited here."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8a87e00cd2f38ba9","start_unit":23,"end_unit":30,"fact_summary":"The manifesto proposed or described policies for democratic governance, rule of law, media freedom, merit recruitment, anti-corruption, banking regulation, money-laundering enforcement, poverty reduction, rural services, youth employment, agriculture, energy, health, education, women, children, minorities, climate adaptation, and peaceful foreign relations.","question_ids":["1B.9","2B.1","2B.7","3B.7","3B.8","4B.1","4B.2","4B.3","4B.4","4B.5","4B.6","4B.7","4B.9","5B.3","5B.5","6B.3","6B.6","6B.7","6B.8","6B.9","8B.1","8B.2","8B.4","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The program was announced on 27 December 2023 for the forthcoming election; many measures were prospective rather than implemented during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The commitments were made by Hasina and the Awami League.","limitations":["The document establishes stated intentions, not implementation or outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8a87e00cd2f38ba9","start_unit":30,"end_unit":30,"fact_summary":"Hasina acknowledged that the government had not been 100% successful, attributed delays to terrorism, disasters, the COVID-19 pandemic, and the Russia-Ukraine and Israel-Palestine wars, accepted responsibility for mistakes, and promised to learn from them while seeking another term.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.9","5B.10","8B.8","8B.9","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly stated in the December 2023 election address and refers to the period ending in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Hasina personally made the acknowledgment and commitment.","limitations":["The speech does not identify specific corrections, replaced implementers, or independently verified adaptations."]},{"source_id":"SRC-69bc4e2123c1621f","start_unit":19,"end_unit":20,"fact_summary":"UNFPA reports that Bangladesh’s 2023 program activities included government participation in initiatives addressing gender-based violence and harmful practices, adolescent skills, gender and social norms, humanitarian action, policy and accountability, population data, quality of care, maternal health, and unmet need for family planning; government spending shares varied by activity.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.9","6B.2","6B.3","6B.5","6B.6","6B.8","6B.9","6B.10","8B.2","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The entries are explicitly labelled Bangladesh 2023 Programme Activities data.","ruler_attribution":"The source records government implementation and financing but does not attribute decisions specifically to Hasina personally.","limitations":["The portal reports program activities and spending, not final outcomes or direct personal direction by the ruler."]},{"source_id":"SRC-69bc4e2123c1621f","start_unit":154,"end_unit":168,"fact_summary":"For Bangladesh’s 2023 activities, UNFPA records substantial spending and government participation in preventing gender-based violence, adolescent and youth programs, gender norms, humanitarian action, policy and accountability, population data, quality of care, maternal health, and family planning.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.9","6B.2","6B.3","6B.5","6B.6","6B.8","6B.9","6B.10","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Explicitly covers Bangladesh 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source attributes implementation to government, UNFPA, NGOs, and UN entities collectively, not specifically to Hasina.","limitations":["Spending and activity records do not establish effectiveness, equitable incidence, or personal ruler control."]},{"source_id":"SRC-69bc4e2123c1621f","start_unit":195,"end_unit":196,"fact_summary":"UNFPA cautions that the transparency portal presents only selected results, many indicators are cumulative or based on annual reports, and some results may have been achieved without UNFPA support or may lack baseline data.","question_ids":["5B.7","6B.5","6B.10","8B.7","8B.8","8B.10"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"The methodological notes qualify interpretation of the 2023 Bangladesh entries.","ruler_attribution":"No direct attribution to Hasina; this is a source-quality and attribution limitation.","limitations":["The notes limit causal attribution and comparison of the portal’s program indicators."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-4c92c6555fbf7303","SRC-8d3ec420d93108c2","SRC-205363d92678bb49"],"batch_limitations":["The ICJ case page concerns Myanmar genocide proceedings and contains no material fact about Hasina or Bangladesh governance during 2023.","The supplied CAT concluding-observations document is for Switzerland, not Bangladesh, despite its title metadata, and therefore provides no reliable Hasina-period evidence.","The Bangladesh Parliament e-clipping page is an index of headlines without article contents; it does not provide sufficiently concrete, attributable facts about Hasina during 2023 beyond isolated headlines."]}
